subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Return of Advertising to Streaming
description: A fast breakdown of The Return of Advertising to Streaming for builders.

hook.text: Netflix launched in 2007 with no ads. In 2022, it introduced an ad-supported tier.

buildup.text: Disney+, Peacock, and HBO Max all followed. Every major streaming platform now offers a cheaper tier with commercials.

discovery.text: Ad-supported tiers make more revenue per user than ad-free subscriptions.

twist.text: Streaming reinvented television by removing ads. Now it's reinventing itself by adding them back.

climax.text: The return of ads to streaming proves that advertising is television's most durable business model.

punchline.text: Streaming killed the ad break. Then brought it back.

quiz.question: Why did streaming services add ad-supported tiers despite originally being ad-free?
options: Ad-supported users generate more revenue per user than subscription-only users
